data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"As n grows, the probability of reaching unanimous consensus tends to 0.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the graph were bipartite or had no cycles, stable mixed obstructions would be absent and consensus could occur.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the initial coloring were sufficiently biased, one color could take over before trapping.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The number of bichromatic edges is a Lyapunov function: each update of a vertex to the majority of its three neighbors strictly decreases this energy.
